main_text.p: Galen. 3. de com-pof.Med. per ge-ner.infin. Herodi-an, lib.1.raro in ejusmodi ludis partes utrinque enecatas esse, præter Athenæum , Plutarchum , te-status estGalenus.Ne dicam in hoc ludi genere periisse Commodum Imperatorem, dum cum robustissimo quo palęstrâ, ad hoc ab iisimmisso, qui ejus Tyrannidē detestabantur, fauces ipsius fuerunt compressæ.

3. Quia nunquam sine ira aut affectu, aut simultate istud genus certaminis celebrari potest; ut pote in quo cuiquè propositum adversarium ferire. Quis enim patietur sibi plagas inferri ab adversario, & quidem non sine dolore, idque animo sedato ? Quis cæstibus excipi ad livorem usque , idque sine odio aut affectuum perturbatione ? Nemo equidem , nisi cui ubique partes corporis callo obductæ sunt.

page.notes: Left margin note is a bare reference, printed in small type in several short lines; transcribed as one note. Long s rendered as plain s throughout. "eft" in "estGalenus" printed without a space; kept as printed. "palęstrâ" and "cuiquè" are uncertain readings of the scan (the ę/è forms are hard to make out); "pote" has a mark over the p that may be a stroke. Spaces before commas and question marks are as printed. Page furniture: page number 30, running head "P. VOET" letterspaced in the scan. Catchword "gui-" at lower right. Faint text in the bottom right corner is not printed matter of this page and is omitted.
